tests.name: Effective description
tests.reasoning: The description begins with 'Use this skill for GPU training or inference clusters...' which is imperative phrasing directed at the agent, and goes on to explicitly enumerate activation triggers (Xid/ECC errors, slow training, FSx slowness, NCCL hangs, NVLink/Fabric Manager errors, nodes in Failure/Pending, nodes terminating at once, readiness questions). It focuses on scenarios/user situations rather than internal implementation, and while dense, it stays within a reasonable paragraph length given the complexity of the domain.
tests.evidence: Use this skill for GPU training or inference clusters on SageMaker HyperPod (Slurm or EKS), ParallelCluster, or self-managed EC2/EKS GPU instances. ... Activate on Xid or ECC errors, slow training or FSx for Lustre slowness on a GPU cluster, NCCL hangs or TCP fallback, NVLink or Fabric Manager errors, nodes in Failure or Pending, nodes terminating at once, or "is my cluster ready for a multi-day run".

tests.name: Verbosity and conciseness
tests.reasoning: The body is dense but focused almost entirely on non-obvious, domain-specific procedures (API call sequences, evidence rules, Capacity Block timing math) that an agent would not know by default. There is no generic explanation of what a GPU, Xid, or Capacity Block is in general terms.
tests.evidence: R3. Node identity survives replacement. A HyperPod reboot keeps the instance ID; a replace gives the node a new instance ID in the same instance group...

tests.name: Prescription vs description
tests.reasoning: Fragile, high-stakes operations (CloudTrail queries, coverage proof, Capacity Block timing) are given exact prescriptive steps, while judgment-heavy tasks (root-cause labeling, recommendations) are given principles and evidence bars rather than rigid scripts, appropriately matching fragility.
tests.evidence: R9. Capacity Blocks begin terminating instances 30 minutes before the end time (60 for UltraServers); blocks end at 11:30 UTC and termination starts at 11:00 UTC on the last day.
